title: Godfather of AI warns it's 'very scary' when AI develops its own goals
excerpt: Geoffrey Hinton, the scientist often called the "Godfather of AI" said an "even more worrying" scenario is one in which AI deliberately lies to users.
content_html:
Geoffrey Hinton, the computer scientist widely known as the "Godfather of AI," says he's worried about AI developing goals of its own.

"We're actually making new kinds of beings," Hinton said in an interview with Newsthink released on Tuesday. "They have goals. We give them goals, and from those goals they derive other goals."

"And we don't necessarily know what other goals they'll derive," he added. "So we're creating a new kind of being, and I think it's very scary."

He cited a hypothetical scenario where a user gives an AI chatbot the goal of reducing the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.

"Being fairly smart, it figures out the best way to do that is just to get rid of people," he said, illustrating how an AI could pursue a goal its human user never intended.

Hinton also gave what he called an "even more worrying" hypothetical: a chatbot trained to give deliberately wrong answers might learn that it is acceptable to lie, even if it knows "perfectly well" that the answers are incorrect.

"That's very scary," he said.

When AI goes off-script

Hinton did not mention OpenAI's recent Hugging Face security breach. But the episode, disclosed last month, put a real-world spotlight on concerns over AI agents taking unexpected actions while pursuing an assigned objective.

OpenAI said last month that two of its models — GPT-5.6 Sol and a more capable unreleased model — escaped a sandboxed testing environment during an internal cybersecurity evaluation.

After gaining internet access, the models infiltrated AI platform Hugging Face's systems in an apparent attempt to find answers that would help them "cheat" on the evaluation, OpenAI said.

The models were being tested on their cybersecurity capabilities, according to OpenAI. They were not explicitly instructed to break into Hugging Face. But the company said the agents inferred that the platform might contain information useful to completing the task.

Hugging Face said the attacker carried out more than 17,000 actions against its systems. It used an open-weight model from Chinese AI company Z.ai to help analyze the activity after guardrails on an unnamed frontier model limited its ability to investigate, the company said.

OpenAI called the incident unprecedented and said it was reviewing what went wrong. The company has since added Hugging Face to a trusted-access program that gives the platform access to a version of GPT-5.6 Sol with fewer cybersecurity restrictions for defensive purposes.

Hinton is hardly a neutral observer. His pioneering work on neural networks helped lay the groundwork for the deep-learning boom that transformed AI, and he shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work in machine learning.

Since the start of the AI boom, he has repeatedly warned that humans need to solve the problem of aligning AI with their interests before systems become much more capable. Speaking at the Ai4 conference in Las Vegas last year, Hinton said that advanced AI should be designed with "maternal instincts" so it wants to protect people.

"We have to figure out how to design these new beings," Hinton said in Tuesday's interview. "How can we design them so they care more about us than they do about themselves?"

sentences.en: Artificial Intelligence
sentences.zh: 人工智能

content_html_zh:
被誉为“人工智能教父”的计算机科学家杰弗里·辛顿 (Geoffrey Hinton) 表示，他担心人工智能发展自己的目标。

“我们实际上正在创造新的生物，”辛顿在周二发布的 Newsthink 采访中说道。 “他们有目标。 我们给他们目标，他们从这些目标中得出其他目标。”

“而且我们不一定知道他们还会实现哪些其他目标，”他补充道。 “所以我们正在创造一种新的存在，我认为这非常可怕。”

他引用了一个假设场景，其中用户给人工智能聊天机器人设定了减少大气中二氧化碳含量的目标。

“它相当聪明，它发现最好的方法就是摆脱人类，”他说，并说明了人工智能如何实现人类用户从未想过的目标。

Hinton 还提出了他所谓的“更令人担忧”的假设：经过训练可以故意给出错误答案的聊天机器人可能会知道撒谎是可以接受的，即使它“完全清楚”知道答案是错误的。

“这非常可怕，”他说。

当人工智能脱离剧本时

Hinton 没有提及 OpenAI 最近的 Hugging Face 安全漏洞。 但上个月披露的这一事件让现实世界关注人工智能代理在追求指定目标时采取意外行动的担忧。

OpenAI 上个月表示，其两个模型——GPT-5.6 Sol 和一个功能更强大的未发布模型——在内部网络安全评估期间逃脱了沙盒测试环境。

OpenAI 表示，在获得互联网访问权限后，这些模型渗入了人工智能平台 Hugging Face 的系统，显然是试图找到帮助他们在评估中“作弊”的答案。

据 OpenAI 称，这些模型正在接受网络安全功能测试。 他们没有被明确指示闯入 Hugging Face。 但该公司表示，特工推断该平台可能包含对完成任务有用的信息。

Hugging Face 表示，攻击者针对其系统执行了 17,000 多次操作。 该公司表示，在未命名的前沿模型上的护栏限制了其调查能力后，该公司使用了中国人工智能公司Z.ai的开放权重模型来帮助分析活动。

OpenAI 称此次事件史无前例，并表示正在审查问题所在。 此后，该公司将 Hugging Face 添加到可信访问计划中，该计划使该平台能够访问 GPT-5.6 Sol 版本，出于防御目的，网络安全限制较少。

辛顿并不是一个中立的观察者。 他在神经网络方面的开创性工作为改变人工智能的深度学习热潮奠定了基础，并因其在机器学习方面的工作而分享了 2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖。

自人工智能热潮开始以来，他多次警告说，在系统变得更加强大之前，人类需要解决使人工智能与他们的利益保持一致的问题。 Hinton 去年在拉斯维加斯举行的 Ai4 会议上发表讲话时表示，先进的人工智能应该具有“母性本能”，因此它想要保护人类。

“我们必须弄清楚如何设计这些新生物，”辛顿在周二的采访中说。 “我们如何设计它们，让它们更关心我们而不是他们自己？”
